# Ondalux Heatmap

> Ondalux Heatmap is free, open-source (MIT / Apache-2.0) desktop software for WiFi heat maps: predictive WiFi network design on floor plans and on-site WiFi site surveys, with professional PDF reports. It runs on Windows as a single portable .exe (no installer, no account, works offline). En español: software gratis y de código abierto para mapas de calor WiFi, diseño de redes WiFi y mediciones en sitio.

Key facts:

- Price: free. License: MIT or Apache-2.0. Source code: https://github.com/auchavez98/ondalux-heatmap
- Platform: Windows 10/11 64-bit, portable executable. macOS and Linux build from source; their WiFi scanning is not yet tested on real hardware.
- Predictive design: import a floor plan (PNG, JPG or PDF), calibrate the scale, draw walls with materials (drywall, glass, brick, concrete, metal, doors and more), place access points, and see predicted coverage instantly.
- Heat maps: signal strength (RSSI), SNR, SINR, number of APs heard, channel overlap and requirements met, for 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz.
- Access point catalog: 105 models from 14 vendors with values from official datasheets; custom models can be entered by hand.
- Ceiling or wall mounting, with a directional pattern and pointing direction for wall-mounted APs.
- Automatic wall detection (beta) from vector PDF floor plans or images.
- On-site survey: record real WiFi scans (Windows), interpolated with IDW or kriging; compare measured vs. predicted coverage.
- Exports: PDF report (English or Spanish) with AP placement, every heat map, coverage gaps and recommendations; PNG heat maps; CSV.
- Privacy: the app sends no data anywhere; no telemetry.
- Interface and reports in English and Spanish.
- Support: support@ondaluxheatmap.com
